text:
alice (sec): quick heads-up — spotted a permissions gap during a canary rollout: devops group could trigger the fallback path even though they shouldn’t have the 'canary_override' right. repro & logs below.

bob (oncall): when did this start?

alice (sec): rolled a role-mapping tweak in PR #3421 around 2026-03-18T02:14Z. changed group binds for canary ops. policy snippet (redacted):

```yaml
roleMappings:
  - role: canary_operator
    binds:
      - group: devops
    precedence: low
  - role: service_admin
    binds:
      - user: alice@redwood.com
    precedence: high
```

alice (sec): runtime evaluated the group bind first due to an internal ordering bug, so the group match granted an allow earlier than the deny rule we have for fallback. that allowed an unintended path.

carol (platform): deploy-bot logs?

deploy-bot: [2026-03-18T03:20:15Z] canary-rollout: user=bob@redwood.com action=trigger_fallback decision=ALLOW rule=group:devops src=api-gateway cluster=prod-cluster-3

ellen (sre): audit event missing kms_key_id and role_evaluation_trace fields for that decision event. we rotated a key last week — without kms_key_id in logs it's hard to tie which key or signing principal made the decision.

dave (devex): possible quick mitigations: revert PR #3421, add explicit deny for fallback_action, and add a policy unit-test that asserts precedence is explicit. I'll open a rollback PR now.

bob (oncall): ack, i'm oncall and blocking manual fallbacks until we confirm. i'll also throttle the canary feature-flag for affected clusters. :no_entry_sign:

alice (sec): opening a security incident SEC-2026 for triage and timeline. I'll collect forensics: evaluation traces, full audit logs, and the change history.

carol (platform): long term: we need to make precedence mandatory in role mappings and have the runtime validate that no implicit ordering is relied on. add schema validation to the API and a release-check script.

ellen (sre): also add kms_key_id to the auth/audit envelope and log the exact role_binding that matched (role_evaluation_trace). we should push a patch to the logging library today.

dave (devex): created rollback PR and added a unit test for precedence. PR: https://git.redwood/ops/PR-3499 — needs review.

bob (oncall): i've created an incident page and pinned it to #incidents. adding links to alert groups.

alice (sec): action items: 1) rollback PR #3421 (dave) 2) add explicit deny on fallback_action + tests (carol) 3) add kms_key_id and role_evaluation_trace to audit schema (ellen) 4) run forensics and customer-impact check (alice) 5) postmortem & comms if any customers affected (legal + comms loop)

carol (platform): i'll own the release for the deny rule and validation, ETA 4 hours.

ellen (sre): rolling logging patch to staging now; will backport to prod after rollback.

dave (devex): rolling back now — will post deploy-bot confirmation.

deploy-bot: [2026-03-18T03:34:02Z] deploy: rollback PR-3421 -> status=SUCCESS target=prod-cluster-3 user=dave (devex)

bob (oncall): confirmed fallback triggers are blocked. monitoring for any anomalous triggers for 30m.

alice (sec): thanks — after we stabilize i'll open a small audit report and attach to SEC-2026. tagging infra, legal, and product for compliance review. :lock: :eyes:
